name: Graph theory
title: Graph theory: the vocabulary every graph paper assumes
blurb: Before anything can be learned on a hypergraph, the hypergraph has to be written down as numbers. This section supplies that vocabulary from zero — vertices, degrees, and the three matrices (adjacency, incidence, Laplacian) that turn a picture into arithmetic. The incidence matrix defined in card 4 is the exact object in the paper's Equation (3).
skip_hint: If you can build an incidence matrix from a picture and say what its row sums mean, skip this section.
